children: KIDZ AI completed an additional closing under its Securities Purchase Agreement, issuing a $1.9 million senior secured convertible note to Solana Growth Ventures. The note bears 7% interest, matures on Sep 17 2028, and is convertible into Class B common stock at an initial price of $3.672 per share. Interest is payable quarterly in cash, added to principal, or in stock, and the note is secured by a first-priority lien. The financing is expected to enhance liquidity for operations and growth.
